nc67d04b019.headline: Rain in America Draws Line in Stable Wheat Mood | Pigbusiness.nl
nc67d04b019.summary: On Euronext, grain prices steadied after losing nearly 15 euros a tonne in two sessions. Rain in the US Midwest and US corn growth trends have shaped sentiment.
nc67d04b019.why: Euronext is the Paris-based exchange where European wheat futures trade, and grain prices feed into food costs and agricultural margins worldwide.

n625d539406.headline: Guinness triples production of zero-alcohol stout amid shifting consumer tastes
n625d539406.summary: Diageo has invested 25 million euros in a new facility at its St James's Gate brewery in Dublin to meet surging demand for non-alcoholic drinks. Guinness zero-alcohol stout production is being tripled.
n625d539406.why: Diageo is the world's largest spirits company and owner of Guinness, so its product mix shifts affect its growth and capital spending.

impacts.name: Diageo
impacts.why: Diageo is investing in capacity to meet demand for non-alcoholic products.

ne3657cd44b.headline: Circles:  Price indication for Thyssenkrupp Nucera at 20 euros per share
ne3657cd44b.summary: There is an initial price indication of 20 euros per share for the planned sale of Thyssenkrupp's hydrogen subsidiary Nucera, according to documents seen by the news agency. The sale is expected at the end of the week.
ne3657cd44b.why: Thyssenkrupp is a German industrial group, and Nucera makes electrolysers for green hydrogen production; its divestment reshapes the parent's portfolio.

nedcc8b6611.headline: Pakistan shares see biggest one-day gain in 15 years post IMF deal
nedcc8b6611.summary: Pakistan's benchmark share index jumped 5.9% on Monday, its biggest single-day gain in 15 years. The rally came on the first trading session after the country secured a last-gasp funding deal from the IMF.
nedcc8b6611.why: The benchmark KSE-100 index in Karachi tracks major Pakistani companies. IMF financing affects the country's balance of payments, currency stability and investor confidence.
nedcc8b6611.why_moved: The share rally followed the country securing a last-minute IMF funding deal, which eased concerns about financing.

n210b1f7503.headline: The Great Divergence Between the Real Economy and Global Equities
n210b1f7503.summary: South Korea's full-month June exports declined 6% year on year, a smaller drop than the 15.2% fall in May but below expectations. Semiconductors and smartphones are key export products.
n210b1f7503.why: South Korea is a major exporter of semiconductors and smartphones, so its export data is widely watched as a gauge of global manufacturing and tech demand.

n9a260ff831.headline: Eurozone PMI manufacturing finalized at 43.4, reacting negatively to ECB hikes
n9a260ff831.summary: The final June Eurozone manufacturing PMI fell to 43.4 from 44.8 in May, its lowest level in 37 months. The output index also dropped to 44.2, an eight-month low.
n9a260ff831.why: The PMI is a monthly survey of purchasing managers that serves as a leading gauge of euro-area factory activity. Weak readings tend to weigh on the euro and on European equities.

n79df16179a.headline: Trade, visas and tigers on agenda for Widodo visit
n79df16179a.summary: Trade, visas and tigers are on the agenda for Indonesian President Widodo's visit, with boosting trade amid Indo-Pacific tensions at the top.
n79df16179a.why: Bilateral trade and investment ties between Australia and Indonesia matter for commodity exports and regional economic stability.

n51869312ef.headline: Daily FX 02.07.23: Big US Data Week To Drive British Pound Vs Euro, Dollar Moves
n51869312ef.summary: Latest US and euro-zone inflation releases came in slightly weaker than expected, setting up a big US data week that could drive currency moves.
n51869312ef.why: Inflation data shapes central bank rate expectations, which in turn drive currency values such as the dollar, euro and pound.

n609a748806.headline: Banks pressed by MPs to make further rate hikes for savings customers
n609a748806.summary: The Treasury Committee has written to the heads of major UK banks asking whether all their savings rates provide fair value to customers. The committee is scrutinising rate pass-through.
n609a748806.why: Deposit rates set by major UK lenders affect bank funding costs, margins and regulatory and political scrutiny of the sector.

n46d1c5c5e6.headline: Dozens of families lose out in home-builder's collapse
n46d1c5c5e6.summary: Dozens of families are in limbo or out of pocket after Bentley Homes, a Melbourne-based home-builder, collapsed. The report describes the company's slide into collapse.
n46d1c5c5e6.why: Residential builders' insolvencies affect construction-sector credit exposure and the housing supply pipeline in Australia.

n4ab8b6de50.headline: Diebold Nixdorf files for bankruptcy
n4ab8b6de50.summary: Diebold Nixdorf has filed for bankruptcy after reaching an agreement to reduce its overall debt by $2.1 billion, affecting its financial stability and creditors.
n4ab8b6de50.why: Bankruptcy impacts the company's operations and its creditors, with potential ripple effects in the financial services technology sector.

n77627e6a09.headline: Super crops are coming: Is Europe ready for a new generation of gene-edited plants?
n77627e6a09.summary: The EU aims to establish a trade agreement with the US to enhance electric vehicle market access and benefits.
n77627e6a09.why: A trade deal could boost EV sales and manufacturing, impacting automotive and related sectors in both regions.

n60891ac482.headline: Borrowing cost rising, says CBN
n60891ac482.summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria reports increased borrowing costs and slowing banking industry growth.
n60891ac482.why: Higher borrowing costs and slower growth affect monetary policy, inflation, and financial stability in Nigeria.

nbe12e6a7b5.headline: RBA pauses interest rate rises 'to assess the state of the economy', ASX closes higher — as it happened
nbe12e6a7b5.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia decided to keep rates unchanged at 4.1% after two rate increases, citing a need to evaluate economic data.
nbe12e6a7b5.why: Interest rate decisions influence borrowing costs, consumer spending, and currency stability in Australia.

n04540454f7.headline: Why Tesla Shares Jumped Again Today
n04540454f7.summary: Tesla's stock rose following record quarterly vehicle production, supporting its annual growth targets.
n04540454f7.why: Increased production indicates strong demand and operational efficiency, positively influencing Tesla's stock and investor confidence.
n04540454f7.why_moved: Record production boosts investor confidence and stock price expectations.

n3ff49fc0c8.headline: Housing lending records strongest lift since last 2021
n3ff49fc0c8.summary: Lending for home purchases in Australia increased, aligning with rising housing prices and indicating a potential boost to the property market.
n3ff49fc0c8.why: Housing lending data impacts mortgage markets, construction, and consumer spending, influencing economic growth in Australia.

nf86100f418.headline: Cyprus tumbles down in global sustainability rankings
nf86100f418.summary: Cyprus ranks lower in the 2023 UN Sustainable Development Report, indicating challenges in sustainability efforts.
nf86100f418.why: Sustainability rankings influence investment climate and policy focus on environmental and social governance.

n234c28c3d5.headline: Greenberg Traurig Mexico Represents Banorte in new Sustainability-linked Financing of USD $100 million for Fibra Macquarie | News | Greenberg Traurig LLP
n234c28c3d5.summary: Greenberg Traurig Mexico represented Banorte in a USD 100 million sustainability-linked loan for Fibra Macquarie.
n234c28c3d5.why: Sustainability-linked financing supports corporate ESG strategies and can influence bank lending and real estate markets.

n9787a64f10.headline: Sydney Harbour island to return to Aboriginal ownership
n9787a64f10.summary: A Sydney Harbour island is set to return to Aboriginal ownership, symbolizing reconciliation.
n9787a64f10.why: The transfer of land ownership can influence local tourism, property values, and cultural heritage investments.

n7702c0d89c.headline: Yen weak, dollar drifts as traders weigh Fed rate hike path
n7702c0d89c.summary: The yen remains below 145 per USD, while the dollar weakens after U.S. rate hike expectations influence currency markets.
n7702c0d89c.why: Currency movements impact export competitiveness and monetary policy outlooks for Japan and the U.S.

n484f2a0063.headline: Ringgit has stabilised, no need to raise OPR
n484f2a0063.summary: Bank Negara Malaysia's recent statement emphasizing economic fundamentals has stabilized the ringgit against the US dollar ahead of the July 6 monetary policy committee meeting.
n484f2a0063.why: Currency stability ahead of policy meetings reflects market confidence and affects trade and capital flows in Malaysia.

n4377ab5ec9.headline: Japan Considers Mild AI Regulations; Goldman Sachs Looks to Exit Apple Partnership - ExchangeWire.com
n4377ab5ec9.summary: Japanese authorities are contemplating moderate AI regulations, while Goldman Sachs is reportedly looking to end its partnership with Apple.
n4377ab5ec9.why: AI regulation and major financial partnerships influence technology sector dynamics and investment strategies.

impacts.name: Goldman Sachs
impacts.why: Potential end of Apple partnership may affect Goldman Sachs' business.

n0044675657.headline: What could the latest retail sales data mean for ASX 200 shares?
n0044675657.summary: Recent retail sales figures in Australia could negatively impact S&P/ASX 200 shares if they lead to further interest rate increases.
n0044675657.why: Retail sales data influence economic outlook and central bank policy, affecting equity valuations on the ASX 200 index.

n1b0036cb78.headline: China new home prices slightly down in June
n1b0036cb78.summary: New home prices in China edged down in June from the previous month, marking a second straight month of declines amid weak housing demand.
n1b0036cb78.why: Housing market trends in China are key indicators of economic health and affect sectors from construction to consumer spending.

n85aed67963.headline: Electric two-wheeler sales in June lowest in 12 months
n85aed67963.summary: Sales of electric two-wheelers in India declined in June, reaching the lowest level in 12 months following the introduction of a subsidy cap.
n85aed67963.why: Electric vehicle sales are sensitive to government incentives; subsidy changes impact adoption rates and industry growth.

na07e7d926d.headline: China puts consumption tax on fuel components
na07e7d926d.summary: China announced a consumption tax on certain fuel blending components effective immediately, according to a joint Ministry of Finance statement.
na07e7d926d.why: Tax changes on fuel components affect energy costs and refining margins, influencing fuel prices and industrial energy expenses in China.

n2d7b8f209b.headline: Treasury Secretary Yellen set to travel to Beijing to help ease U.S.-China relations
n2d7b8f209b.summary: Treasury Secretary Yellen plans to visit Beijing to help improve U.S.-China economic relations amid ongoing tensions.
n2d7b8f209b.why: U.S.-China relations impact global trade, investment flows, and financial markets, making this visit significant for international economic stability.

n6df9239ac1.headline: Nestle steps up reforestation project in Ivory Coast - Latest News
n6df9239ac1.summary: Nestlé's reforestation project in Ivory Coast aims to combat deforestation caused by cocoa farming, impacting the regional supply chain.
n6df9239ac1.why: Sustainable practices in cocoa sourcing can influence supply stability and commodity prices.

n88576df009.headline: World Bank supports Vietnam
n88576df009.summary: The World Bank supports Vietnam with a $264 million credit to bolster economic development efforts.
n88576df009.why: International funding can support infrastructure, social programs, and economic growth in Vietnam.

n0be89625c2.headline: Korean cosmetics capturing hearts
n0be89625c2.summary: South Korean beauty brands are expanding in Vietnam, leveraging cultural influence to meet demand for high-quality products.
n0be89625c2.why: Growth in cosmetics exports reflects cultural influence and can boost related sectors and trade figures.

n4ca7d7003e.headline: How Gov. Evers could shape the budget using his veto power • Wisconsin Examiner
n4ca7d7003e.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia’s minutes show a 'clearly restrictive' stance amid inflation and growth concerns.
n4ca7d7003e.why: RBA policy outlook affects Australian interest rates, currency, and economic stability.

ne106e52a14.headline: Real estate businesses yet to recover
ne106e52a14.summary: Vietnam's real estate sector shows continued decline in new businesses and capital in the first half of the year.
ne106e52a14.why: Weak real estate activity can signal broader economic slowdown and affect construction and finance sectors.

n306dda4103.headline: Sumitomo explores investment in Thanh Hoa province
n306dda4103.summary: Japanese conglomerate Sumitomo signed an MoU with Thanh Hoa authorities to explore investment opportunities.
n306dda4103.why: Foreign investment in Vietnam's provinces can boost local economic development and corporate earnings.

nd232a5ec38.headline: IMF says Vietnam
nd232a5ec38.summary: The IMF team led by Paulo Medas concluded discussions with Vietnam on economic policies and outlook.
nd232a5ec38.why: IMF assessments influence policy reforms and investor perceptions of economic stability.

nf8c55dfaa8.headline: South Korea factory activity suffers longest downturn in at least 19 years
nf8c55dfaa8.summary: Factory activity in South Korea shrank at a record pace, extending a 12-month downturn amid economic slowdown.
nf8c55dfaa8.why: Manufacturing decline signals economic weakness and affects related sectors and investor sentiment.

n6855dcbde1.headline: Yellen to visit China
n6855dcbde1.summary: US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen will visit Beijing to discuss managing US-China relations and address economic concerns.
n6855dcbde1.why: Yellen's visit is significant as it represents high-level engagement between the world's two largest economies amid ongoing tensions, impacting global trade and investment.

n80f9a1f298.headline: Wall Street Aims To Open Broadly Up
n80f9a1f298.summary: US markets are expected to open higher ahead of the Federal Open Market Committee minutes and monthly jobs report later this week.
n80f9a1f298.why: FOMC minutes and jobs data are critical for assessing US monetary policy and economic health, influencing global markets.
n80f9a1f298.why_moved: Expectations for key US economic data have increased market optimism ahead of releases.

nd036c6570e.headline: Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen is making a long-awaited trip to China this week
nd036c6570e.summary: Janet Yellen will travel to Beijing as part of the Biden administration's ongoing efforts to improve U.S.-China relations.
nd036c6570e.why: High-level U.S.-China economic diplomacy can influence trade, investment, and geopolitical risk, affecting global markets and multinational companies.
nd036c6570e.why_moved: The visit signals potential easing of U.S.-China tensions, which can reduce geopolitical risk premiums and influence global trade and markets.

n34d8790398.headline: Hike in gas, power tariff inevitable ahead of IMF board meeting
n34d8790398.summary: Pakistan plans to increase gas rates by 45-50% and power tariffs by Rs3.50-Rs4 per unit to meet IMF conditions and secure funding.
n34d8790398.why: Energy tariff hikes are often IMF conditions to reduce fiscal deficits but can impact inflation and public sentiment.
n34d8790398.why_moved: The tariff hikes are critical IMF conditions, impacting inflation expectations and fiscal outlook in Pakistan.

nc1a920e56c.headline: New BSP chief hits ground running
nc1a920e56c.summary: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor Eli Remolona vowed to maintain policy continuity as the Philippines continues economic recovery from the pandemic impact.
nc1a920e56c.why: Central bank leadership and policy direction are critical for monetary stability and investor confidence in the Philippines.
